steps.reason: These columns are unsuitable for predicting survival before the outcome: name is high-cardinality personal information, boat and body record post-outcome information, and cabin and home.dest are being dropped as requested.
pclass represents passenger class rather than a measured quantity, so treat its values as categories instead of implying numeric distances between classes.
Create a held-out test set for evaluating classification performance while preserving the target's class proportions.
age and fare have missing values; their medians are suitable imputations, particularly given fare's strong skew and many outliers.
embarked has two missing values, so fill them with the most frequent observed port before encoding.
fare has many outliers, so robust scaling is appropriate for the numeric predictors and also supports linear models.
Convert pclass, sex, ticket, and embarked into numeric features for modeling; cap ticket's one-hot expansion by grouping its rarest categories.
